final_candidates.decision_summary: Proline substitution at Trp17 is likely to disrupt local backbone geometry and aromatic packing in this small subunit.
Adjacent to W17, Tyr18-to-Pro may strongly perturb local secondary structure and neighboring aromatic interactions.
Replacing hydrophobic Ile33 with Asp may introduce an unfavorable charge into a buried or structurally important region.

stop_reason.detail: The leading candidates are selected from the reviewed pool and no external evidence is available to justify further iteration.

history.rationale: Replacing the conserved aromatic residue with proline can introduce a backbone kink and disrupt local secondary structure. This is likely to strongly destabilize the compact 68-residue subunit.
A proline substitution at a conserved aromatic residue is likely to disrupt local secondary structure and packing in this small subunit.

Proline substitution at this aromatic position may disrupt backbone geometry and remove hydrophobic/aromatic packing. The adjacent aromatic cluster makes local structural perturbation especially plausible.
Replacing Tyr with Pro immediately adjacent to W17 may strongly perturb the local backbone and aromatic packing.

Introducing a charged aspartate at an internal-looking hydrophobic position is likely to impair packing and destabilize the fold. This preserves a single-site mutation while creating a strong polarity mismatch.
The hydrophobic-to-charged change may destabilize a buried hydrophobic environment while avoiding proline-specific uncertainty.
Proline at Val36 may break a structured hydrophobic segment and restrict the local backbone. Loss of hydrophobic packing further supports folding disruption.
Proline at Val36 is a plausible backbone-disrupting substitution within the central structured region.
This substitution removes an aromatic packing residue and introduces a conformationally restrictive proline. The combined effects are expected to compromise local structure.
Replacing a hydrophobic aromatic residue with proline may disrupt both packing and local secondary structure.
Replacing valine with aspartate introduces an unfavorable charge into a likely hydrophobic region. Such a polarity and size change can weaken the native fold.
A Val-to-Asp substitution could introduce an unfavorable charge if this residue contributes to a hydrophobic core.
A proline near the C-terminal structured region may disrupt terminal secondary structure and packing. The mutation also removes a hydrophobic leucine contribution.
Proline near the C-terminal structured region may weaken terminal packing, though its impact is less certain than central substitutions.
Aspartate would eliminate aromatic packing at Tyr34 while adding a charge. This may destabilize the central structured region if the residue is partially buried.
Introducing Asp at an aromatic position may disrupt hydrophobic packing, but solvent exposure at this site is uncertain.
